mode: live API source review; advisory only, no production validation

interpolation_claim.instructions: Does this service report AI enhancement despite bypassing both actual enhancement engines for a source that needs enlargement?

compression_regression.instructions: Does the supplied saved-master path still send the newly prepared master through ordinary 2048px preview compression?

premature_success.instructions: Does the supplied canvas handler report successful saved enlargement before its explicit durable StorageService.saveItem call resolves?

focal_loss.instructions: Does the supplied plan enhance only a centered crop before applying the requested focus point, losing content needed for off-center focal crops?
